prompts.epic_class_shop_v1:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished full-bleed raster concept for Racing Manager, a portrait mobile game screen. Exact canvas 390 pixels wide by 844 pixels tall, or a precise integer multiple of 390x844. No phone frame or presentation labels. Vietnamese typography, all accents correct, crisp and readable at logical 390px.
Input images are reference images only: reference 1 approved Shop establishes Soft Miniature cream panels, soft bevels, blue banners, orange purchase buttons, navy rounded bold type; reference 2 establishes tactile miniature toys and warm light; reference 3 establishes the existing Epic popup composition; reference 4 establishes existing Epic Shop carousel. Preserve those visual and layout languages. Soft Miniature: sculpted rounded toy-clay vehicles, gentle gloss, soft ambient shadows, warm cream, saturated blue, purple rarity glow and golden stars. No photorealism.
Business invariants: one Epic vehicle for each separate racing class, each bought once for 9.99 USD and restorable. Six exact class names: Racing, Rally, Stock Car, Superbike, Speedster, Monster Truck. Epic stats equal highest stats of its tier multiplied by 1.09. Do not invent numeric stat values or rewards. Four stat rows with icons and exactly FIVE clearly separated equal segments each are illustrative only, no absolute numbers. Do not show old Pico/Nova/Apex/Titan/Zenith offers.
Primary request: Shop scrolled to existing XE EPIC section; keep horizontal product carousel and surrounding shop language, add only class selection above cards.
Composition: full 390x844 screen. Compact blue Shop title at top without wallet numbers. Blue rounded section banner "XE EPIC" with gift icon and checker accent. Cream outer section. Directly below banner a SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW of SIX compact class chips, all fully visible, in this exact order: "Racing", "Rally", "Stock Car", "Superbike", "Speedster", "Monster Truck". Fit with 9–10 logical px legible type; longer names may wrap inside chips. Exactly one active chip "Rally" in purple, others pale cyan. Below chips, horizontal carousel with ONE full central portrait offer card for the selected class, occupying about 280 logical px, and slim clipped neighboring card edges at left and right; no second full offer, no grid. Neighbor contents cropped beyond readability, no contradictory names or prices. Tiny page dots and swipe cue.
Selected full card: purple luminous stage with gold stars, small purple "EPIC" flag, blue-and-cream checker circular turntable. Hero is a distinctive compact RALLY CAR, closed hatchback with roof scoop, rally lamp cluster, rear spoiler, chunky gravel tires, pearl purple-blue paint and gold stripe, no lettering on body. Large name "RALLY EPIC". Cyan badge with winding dirt circuit icon and exact "Rally". Small text "Chỉ dùng ở class Rally". Four compact stat rows labeled "Tốc độ", "Tăng tốc", "Vào cua", "Ổn định", FIVE separated colored blocks per row. Below stats, exact two-line formula "Chỉ số cao nhất của hạng × 1,09". Wide glossy orange purchase button "$9.99", logical height exactly 44px minimum. Small readable line "Mua một lần • Có thể khôi phục".
Below section retain only the "BỘ SƠN EPIC" blue banner and the very top of its existing cream card row to imply continued scrolling; do not introduce new offers or prices. Bottom blue navigation five tabs with miniature icons and exact labels "Đua", "Túi", "Đội", "Giải", "Shop"; Shop selected orange.
Avoid extra text, countdowns, discounts, fake rewards, other currency values, watermarks. Make the selected vehicle and the six-chip class selection visually clear.
